system.story: Turn their own guns around - the crew's ghost in the machine.

description.value:
Subclass: Disruptor (Offensive Decker). You are the best of the Hacker's specialties at stripping the enemy's tech advantage - crashing, jamming, and hijacking devices, smartguns, and drones in the thick of the fight. Turn their own gear into a liability.

Role Feature - Weaponized Static

Your Electronic Warfare signature hits a larger area, and on an Outcome Tier 1 it redirects one enemy drone or turret to your side for a round, free of Bandwidth.

Signature Tweak

Your Subvert can hit a smartgun or cyberweapon at a bane before you fully breach it (opportunistic jamming - their reticles die).

Bonus Skill

A free pick by subclass flavor: Electronic Warfare (demolitions-adjacent tech).

Contact

A drone-runner or arms-dealer who feeds your taste for other people's hardware.

Corp Records

Hostile-EW systems consultant.
